content: Am da Kristus Nug kobol aḏi aḏi heum ele amu andeṯe, da kobol amu dim lamidṯem, amubia ag ele da aniḏnana da heṯem bia heig!
KAYAK BINAG MAK HAENP̱A IḴI HAUTAK KOBOL
Ag hanhan dahil dab meṯeb, nai da ag amelagp̱a aṯem ele amu, ag tutuḵu aon aḏaṯeb amunu da ahilagnu ool ena dayeye, ag am genab kobol ena heṯeb awe aṯem.
Amge ag nai imu dooglagnu da ool daaṯe. Danab oh iḵilag am Kristus, ah iḵi am danab, Kristus iḵi am Kayak.
Anam daaṯe amunu danab nug unuqidḵunu o iiṯa nai mehuqḵunu haaha, iḵi haut-te, nug aaḵu Kayak aben meḵom daaṯe amu kakidṯe. Aben amuam danab nug Kristus waap̱a daaṯe.

Am ah laa nug iḵi ii hauta, unuqidḵunu o Kayak nai mehuqḵunu haaha, nug ele Kayak aben meḵom daaṯe amu kakidṯe. Aben amuam ah nug danab waap̱a daaṯe. Nug iḵi ii haut-te amu ah nug iḵi uḏug oh hoiṯe bia heṯe. Am uḏa nak ele.
Amu ah nug iḵi hautaknu uuṯe amu nug iḵi uḏug hoiaḏ! Amge nug iḵi uḏug hoiyaknu uḏa nak dooṯe dayeb amu aria nug iḵi hautaḏ!
Aria danab nug iḵi amu aib hautom. Am aḏinu? Danab ag Kayak aḏi bia daaṯe amu nuhig g̱agaṯag ele doṯog bia daaṯeb amge ah ag danab aḏi bia daaṯeb amunu doṯog daaṯeb amunu ag iḵilag hauteg!
Kayak Nug ah beḏup̱a danab ii heum. Iiṯa. Nug danab beḏup̱a ah heum.
Am ele Kayak Nug ahnu dab ma, danab ah ehanidḵunu ii heum. Iiṯa. Nug danabnu dab ma, ah nug danab ehanidḵunu heum.
Kayak Nug ah, danabnu heum amunu ah ag engel noolagp̱a ena daaglagnu iḵilag hauteg!
Amge ig Naḏi ele ou qak daaṯem ele amu, ihinigp̱a ah nug nuḵa piḏe ii daaṯe. Danab nug ele nuḵa piḏe ii daaṯe. Iiṯa. Ah nug danabnu ehaniṯak aoṯe, danab nug ahnu ehaniṯak ele aoṯe.
Kayak Nug ah heḵunu amu Nug danab beḏu laih awa heum anamib gemu danab ahp̱a doṯeb amge Kayak Nug keeke oh Mameg daaṯe.
Ag imu tutuḵu epeḏin anṯeg! Ah laa nug iḵi ii hauta, Kayak unuqidṯe amu nug kobol tutuḵu heṯete?
Am Kayak Nug ig danab ah beḏunig aben aben meḵomp̱a daagnignu anidṯem am danab laa nug iḵi uḏug elab ele daaṯe amuam eheḏ iite ip̱unigṯe?
Amge ah laa nug iḵi uḏug elab ele oiḵu amu ena, am nuhig bala. Aḏinu? Kayak Nug ah iḵi uḏug elab heum amunu amup̱a nug iḵi haut-te.
Amu danab laa nug nai imu tap̱eb neeb, awa awa qeṯak nai maṯiaya heṯe amu nug doyaḏ! Ig kobol amunu ḏo laa ii meṯem, Kayaknu kristen tamaniak oop̱a ele anamib daaṯe.
E GUN LANAKNU KOBOL TUTUḴU

Aria da keeke laanu madiḵulnu heṯem amu da amunu binalag ii meṯem. Am inam. Ag ahi eṯaglagnu qag menana amu ag kobol tutuḵu ii aḏaṯeb. Danab ag qag mak amup̱a ehaniṯak aolob amge iiṯa, ag nakok eheḏ bia aoṯeb.
Amu laa ag haen ag Korint ag Kayak nai dooglagnu qag meṯeb amu ag obatak obatak daaṯeb, laip̱u oh ii daaṯeb, anam aeg doomi amu da nakok oolp̱a genab dooṯem.
Aḏinu? Ag enanag ii heṯeb amunu obatak amubia genab beḵu amge amup̱a Kayak Nug heeb, ag oolagp̱a danab aun aḏi ag tutuḵu daaṯeb ele amu, ag miag atiglag.
Ag anam daaṯeb amu haen ag oh qag meṯeb amup̱a ag, “Ig Naḏinu e laṯem,” aon aṯeb amge ag anam ii heṯeb.
Iiṯa! Ag oh aḵa aḵa ahilag e aḵa laṯeb amunu laa e iiṯa ele daaṯe amu, nug enug dayeye, aria danab laa nug le g̱agaṯag huan lawowa kaaka qeṯe.

Amu aṯemu? Ag e le ele laḵulagnu laulḵad iiṯate? Ag Kayaknu kristen tamaniak amu keeke hamu bia dooṯebte? Ag lailḵad laala, e iiṯa ele daaṯeb amu, ag ag anadna ahilagnu dab mak ii aona, uḏa nak madaṯebte? Ag heṯeb amu da amunu aḏi aḵul? Da ag binalag meḵulte? Iiṯa! Kobol amunu amu da ag binalag iinab mepa.

Da nai imu Naḏi Jesus Nug oḏep̱a nai awen, da ag amelagp̱a tatam ami amu da gemu eḏuen baula aṯem. Nai amuam inam. “Judas Nug tuqan Naḏi Jesus awa, kekeḏ ep̱elagp̱a meum, tuqan amup̱a Naḏi Jesus Nug bret awa
Kayak unuqiṯowa, pane ne amu Nug aum. ‘Bret imu amu da beḏul ip̱unigṯe. Amup̱a da ag ehanadḵul. Da ag ehanadḵulnu hemi, amu ag daulagp̱a doḵunu, ag bret, ig gemu laṯem, amubia laig!’

Ag e lana malona amubia Nug hai goḵoḏ awa, Nug aum. ‘Hai goḵoḏ imup̱a wain daaṯe amu da tiil ip̱unigṯe. Da tiilp̱a Kayak Nug tituanak bau qagaṯe. Ag lanana amu da ag ehanadḵulnu hemi, amu ag daulagp̱a doḵunu ag wain, ig gemu laṯem, amubia laig!’” Jesus Nug anam aum.
Amu genab, ag hanhan Jesus eḏua ii nak haen imup̱a, bret imu wain imu ele lanana, ag Naḏi Jesus mauhomnu nai amu mehuqṯeb.
Amunu danab laa nug oo babaiṯak iiṯa, nug Naḏinu bret o wain hamu awa laṯe amu, nug amup̱a Naḏi Jesus beḏu, tiig ele am keeke hamu bia doya, nug Jesus nuhigp̱a hip̱unin heṯe.
Danab nug nuḵa epeḏiṯa anṯowa aria nug Naḏinu e gun ele amu nug laḵu.
Aḏinu? Danab nug nuhig oiyak elele iiṯap̱a, Naḏi Jesus beḏu tiig ele amu dab ii medaṯa, nug hamu laṯe amu nuḵa nuhig ab aaḵu laṯe.
Diig amup̱a ag oolagp̱a danab ah laala ag g̱agaṯag iiṯa, laala ag oḏe aona, laala mauhadp̱ig.
Ig iḵa ig epeḏidta, elele anidta laḵunig am beḏunigp̱a ab iiṯa daagnig.
Amu Kayak Nug ig aḏi heṯem aniḵa, Nug ihinig hak amu epeḏiṯa, ig danab Kayak ii dim lamidṯeb ele oh padal ii mematanu, ig ena beḵunignu Nug ig toliḵa, bu iqaqa bap̱aigṯe.
Anam aaḵu amunu o dahilad, ag e lanaknu qag meṯeb, ag aḵa aḵa aib e paha lap̱ig. Laala uḏiglagnu amelag meig!
Ag mauhnoak e laṯeb amubia tuḏidna labep̱eg, Kayak epeḏiak baubau maṯamanu amu laa nug enug qeeb, nug nuḵa nug laugp̱a e lanaḏ! Nai imu gogp̱a ii temi amge dimp̱a da uḵe, ap̱a bap̱aidḵul.
